name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Specialist | SaaS Onboarding, AI Product Adoption & Customer Configuration
summary: Customer onboarding and implementation professional with 15+ years taking SaaS customers from kickoff to live, including launching 25+ clients per month at Wix while holding 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets. Builds and ships AI-driven systems personally, architecting LLM-powered agent workflows and personalized outreach engines at Solenzo, the kind of product Distill builds for its own customers. Comfortable defining process from scratch in early-stage environments, having driven a new business vertical from proof of concept to a profitable line at Wix and founded and run Solenzo independently since 2024.
